test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five students I, J, K, L and M are sitting on a bench in a straight row, facing North. M and J are immediate neighbours. M and K are also immediate neighbours, I is on the extreme left of the bench. J is sitting second from the extreme right. Who is sitting between I and J?
solution: Five students I, J, K, L and M are sitting on a bench in a straight row, facing North. 1) I is on the extreme left of the bench and J is sitting second from the extreme right.
